name: Evil Parrot 13
author: McHaXYT
description: Gradient rounded violet button that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, box-shadow becomes inset 0 5px 25px 0 #af40ff, inset 0 10px 15px 0px #5b42f3,
    inset 0 5px 25px 0px #00ddeb.
html:
<button class="button">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="1.25rem"
    height="1.25rem"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    stroke-width="2"
  >
    <path d="M12 19v-7m0 0V5m0 7H5m7 0h7"></path>
  </svg>
  Create
</button>
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Evil Parrot 13</title>
<style>
/* Evil Parrot 13 by McHaXYT — https://uiverse.io/McHaXYT/evil-parrot-13 */
.button {
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.5rem;
  padding: 0.625rem 1rem;
  color: rgb(242 242 242);
  background-color: rgb(79 70 229);
  background: linear-gradient(144deg, #af40ff, #5b42f3 50%, #00ddeb);
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  border-style: none;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  transition: all 0.35s linear;
}

.button:hover {
  box-shadow: inset 0 5px 25px 0 #af40ff, inset 0 10px 15px 0px #5b42f3,
    inset 0 5px 25px 0px #00ddeb;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="1.25rem"
    height="1.25rem"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    stroke-width="2"
  >
    <path d="M12 19v-7m0 0V5m0 7H5m7 0h7"></path>
  </svg>
  Create
</button>

</body>
</html>
